key_insight: PUST decouples costly exploration from policy alignment by using a lightweight proxy model to discover useful behaviors and then transferring only the relative improvement signal to the main LLM.
engineering_relevance: This makes post-training more modular, cheaper, and reusable, enabling asynchronous optimization signals that can transfer across models and support weak-to-strong improvement.
method: Use a proxy LLM to perform exploratory optimization instead of the primary model
Extract the directional update signal from the proxy’s pre- and post-optimization states
Transfer that reusable signal to the target model for alignment
evidence_signal: The abstract reports systematic evaluations on Qwen3-family models in math and code, showing that signals from much weaker proxies can robustly improve stronger primary models.
watch_item: Transfer quality may depend on how well the proxy’s improvement signal matches the target model and task, so signal calibration and domain fit are important.
paper_title: Proxy Exploration and Reusable Guidance: A Modular LLM Post-Training Paradigm via Proxy-Guided Update Signals
